late_source_policy: no_new_entries_for_the_hour; existing exchange positions remain protected and minute-monitored
activation_rule: explicit user-authorized manual override of duration/count gates and explicit unattended minute-monitor approval; causal, freshness, identity, policy and row-local fail-closed gates remain mandatory
entry_order: market inside the canonical 900-second decision window after frozen MC1_d2 admission and portfolio acceptance
execution_adjusted_ev: only MC1_d2-admitted and portfolio-accepted rows are checked; raw expected net is reduced by adverse decision-open delay and excess live spread/order-book impact above the embedded 100-bps policy cost; adjusted EV must remain at least +50 bps
protective_stop: exchange-side reduce-only stop installed immediately before entry acceptance
position_monitor: persistent process wakes every 60 seconds and reuses strict_r3_shadow_portfolio.advance_shadow_state on completed 15-minute bars; it can only confirm exits, close timeout/trailing exits and tighten stops
adaptive_exit_role: hourly activation-only modulation of the SimplePolicyOptimiser parent; parent activation is the fallback
independent_replay_role: offline audit only; exact identities and <=0.01-percent numerical tolerance; never in the live critical path
